editorial.blurb: A casual, customizable Vietnamese spot in the Loop that delivers delicious banh mi and pho at budget-friendly prices, perfect for a quick lunch rush.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive before noon to beat the crowds and enjoy a calmer atmosphere, and enroll in their phone app to earn a $10 discount after five points.
signatureDishes: Tofu Noodle Bowl with Peanut Sauce
